Sofia, here are the bullets for your note to June. I haven't sent anything to June.

- **Rename:** Pellow Home Living (PHL) was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- **Clash:** PHL is also the shorthand for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, the Gulf Coast terminal account. Filtering "PHL" returns both, so the Feb 17 thread in #coastal-team called it out.
- **Stale label:** Moss's 18 May coverage note says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". You said on Feb 17 you'd relabel the saved retail view, so this one may have been missed. I haven't opened the report itself to confirm the label.
- **Ask:** Could the saved report be relabelled to "Pellow Home Living" (or to the full name, to avoid the PHL clash)?
